newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Energy unit gets OK on pipeline.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Energy unit gets OK on pipeline.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp's Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co unit said Thursday it has won federal regulatory approval for plans to build a $24 million, 7.5-mile-long natural gas pipeline in New England.

The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission authorized Tennessee Gas to proceed with connecting the Everett, Mass., facility of Distrigas of Massachusetts Corp to Tennessee Gas' existing pipeline system, the company said in a press release.
Distrigas is a unit of Cabot LNG Corp and Cabot Corp. The pipeline is expected to be on line by November 1998, the company said.
